items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Dick' ('No, I never could sing, Dick.'), indicating 'Dick' refers to the interviewer, Richard B. 'Dick' Allen. No other personal relationship or interaction with this person is described in the transcript.

ctx.x: Did you sing when you played guitar?

No, I never could sing, Dick. But I could play good guitar. Yeah, I could pick all them songs I could. And what about? Pick games and different things. But now I can't play nothing. I forgot about it. That's true. I can make a few chords, but. When did you pick up trombone then? I took up trombone in 1970.
